title: Keep Multiplying Found Values by Two
statement:
Begin with the number `original`. As long as the current number appears somewhere in the array `nums`, replace it with twice its value. As soon as the current number is missing from `nums`, stop.

Return the number you end with.
notes:
## Intuition

The process asks the same question again and again: "is this number in `nums`?" Scanning the whole array for each question costs O(n) every time. Putting the values in a hash set first turns every question into an O(1) lookup, and the chain of doublings is short anyway, because the values never exceed 1000.

## Approach

1. Put every value of `nums` into a set `seen`.
2. Set `current` to `original`.
3. While `seen` contains `current`, double `current`.
4. When the lookup fails, return `current`.

## Example 1, step by step

`nums = [5, 3, 6, 1, 12]`, so `seen = {5, 3, 6, 1, 12}`, and `current` starts at `original = 3`.

- `3` is in `seen`, so `current` becomes `6`.
- `6` is in `seen`, so `current` becomes `12`.
- `12` is in `seen`, so `current` becomes `24`.
- `24` is not in `seen`, so the answer is `24`.

## Complexity

- Time: O(n + log(1000)): building the set is O(n), and the value at least doubles each round, so it passes 1000 after at most about 10 rounds.
- Space: O(n) for the set.

## Pitfalls

- Stop at the first missing value, even if a larger multiple appears later in the chain (`[3, 6, 24]` with `original = 3` gives `12`, not `48`).
- Look through all of `nums` for each number, not only the part after the previous match: the chain can appear in any order, as in `[12, 6, 3]`.
- If `original` is not in `nums` at all, return it unchanged.

## Variables

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `seen` | set of all values in `nums` |
| `value` | one element of `nums` while the set is built |
| `current` | the number being searched for, doubled while it is found |

narration.2: Prepare an empty set to hold the values of nums.
narration.3: Visit every value in the array once.
narration.4: Add it to the set, so later membership checks take constant time.
narration.8: Keep going while the current number is present in the array.
narration.9: Found it: double the number and look again.
narration.12: The current number is missing, so the process stops and this is the answer.
